{"category_edits":[{"category":"feature_construction","rationale":"Scale observed context embeddings using training-only item frequencies to reduce frequent-item dominance. Normalize inverse-quarter-power log counts to mean one, then clip to [0.75, 1.25]. Padding, mask tokens, unseen items and candidate embeddings retain unit scale. A persistent buffer saves the feature with each checkpoint; the generated predictor imports the same model class and restores it automatically. Learned embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain fixed.","edits":[{"find":"        self.item_emb = nn.Embedding(itemnum + 2, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(maxlen + 1, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)","replace":"        self.register_buffer("input_scale", torch.ones(itemnum + 2))

        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(maxlen + 1, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)"},{"find":"        x = self.item_emb(seq) * (self.hidden_units ** 0.5) + self.pos_emb(pos)","replace":"        x = self.item_emb(seq) * self.input_scale[seq].unsqueeze(-1) * (self.hidden_units ** 0.5) + self.pos_emb(pos)"},{"find":"    ).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)","replace":"    ).to(device)
    item_counts = np.zeros(itemnum + 2, dtype=np.int64)
    for history in user_train.values():
        np.add.at(item_counts, np.asarray(history, dtype=np.int64), 1)
    observed = item_counts[1:itemnum + 1] > 0
    input_scale = np.ones(itemnum + 2, dtype=np.float32)
    if observed.any():
        observed_ids = np.flatnonzero(observed) + 1
        frequency_scale = np.log1p(item_counts[observed_ids].astype(np.float64)) ** (-0.25)
        frequency_scale /= frequency_scale.mean()
        input_scale[observed_ids] = np.clip(frequency_scale, 0.75, 1.25).astype(np.float32)
    with torch.no_grad():
        model.input_scale.copy_(torch.as_tensor(input_scale, device=device))
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)"}]}],"change_summary":"Add checkpointed training-frequency input scales consistently across all four category models, with automatic restoration by the existing predictor writer."}
